<!-- Generated by `deltac gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

An explore construction needs an `alphabet` clause: the input alphabet of the machine it builds.

## Example

```delta error
let M = explore {
  start 0
  step q on a -> q
  accept q if true
}
```
